subject.title: fix(qa): resolve profile channels through selected driver

question: Should the QA-lab owner accept driver-level grouping of portable scenarios by `execution.channel` for `live` runs without an explicit channel override?
rationale: The patch changes QA orchestration rather than production messaging, and its MEMBER author plus protected `maintainer` label require a human owner to confirm the intended suite-driver boundary before merge.

options.title: Accept the driver-level partitioning
options.body: Merge after confirming that portable scenarios should be grouped by their declared logical channel while the selected live driver remains interchangeable.

options.title: Request an alternate QA contract
options.body: Keep the PR open if QA-lab ownership wants channel eligibility or adapter resolution to remain owned elsewhere in the suite-launch path.

recommendation.title: Accept the driver-level partitioning
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming that portable scenarios should be grouped by their declared logical channel while the selected live driver remains interchangeable.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the active MEMBER contributor for the proposed QA-lab contract and can route the final owner review.
